payment_id.description: Unique primary key for payment transaction.

work_id.description: Unique primary key for each work/project record.

mp_id.description: Foreign key linking work to standard Member of Parliament identifier.

implementing_agency.description: District executing department or authority name.

payment_amount.description: Monetary amount disbursed in payment transaction (INR).

payment_type.description: Payment transfer mode (Cheque, Bank Transfer, ECS).

is_vendor_blacklisted.description: Binary flag (1 if payee vendor is blacklisted).

is_blacklisted_vendor_payment_anomaly.description: Anomaly flag (1 if payment made to blacklisted vendor).

synthetic_record.description: Flag indicating if record is synthetically generated (True/False).

synthetic_scenario.description: Synthetic scenario pattern applied (NORMAL, COST_OVERRUN, etc.).
